name: mm_math_benchmark
description: mm_math_benchmark evaluates models' ability to solve multimodal mathematics problems that combine text and images (diagrams, equations, tables). It measures both the correctness of final answers and the capacity to handle visual mathematical reasoning across a range of topics. Tasks span short-answer and multiple-choice formats and require symbolic manipulation and diagram interpretation.
reputation: A niche but growing dataset used by researchers studying visual/math reasoning in multimodal models.
